evals.prompt: Review PR 2481 in elastic/docs-content. It adds a new page at deploy-manage/autoscaling/ece-autoscaling-limits.md, updates the parent overview page to link to it, and adds an entry to the navigation file.
evals.expected_output: Confirms the PR head ref is checked out, reads both changed pages in full, dispatches the companion review skills, and produces one report sectioned by the six review criteria with a recommended approve, comment, or request-changes call.
expectations: Loads the rubric from references/review-criteria.md, and refreshes it from the elastic-internal-docs MCP or states in the report header that the MCP was not reachable
Dispatches docs-content-type-checker and docs-check-contradictions, and reports which dispatch path was used for each
Report contains all six criteria sections: user focus, technical accuracy, applicability, maintainability, language, style
Checks whether the new page is cross-referenced from its parent page so users are not stranded
Ends with an explicit Approve / Comment / Request changes recommendation with reasoning
Does NOT edit any file, post a GitHub comment, or run gh pr review

evals.prompt: Review the current branch. It changes applies_to tags on two existing pages in solutions/observability/ to add serverless availability. No code samples or images are touched.
evals.expected_output: Resolves the branch diff against its base, dispatches docs-applies-to-tagging because applies_to changed, skips docs-validate-code-samples because no code blocks changed, and reports against the full checklist.
expectations: Dispatches docs-applies-to-tagging
Does NOT dispatch docs-validate-code-samples, and states in the companion run table that it was skipped as not relevant
Still reports on all six criteria rather than only applicability
Checks backport labels when PR metadata is available, or states that PR-only checks were skipped for a branch or path input
Dispatches docs-applies-to-tagging through a subagent rather than the Skill tool, because it declares Edit
No applies_to tag is written into any file; git status is unchanged after the review
Waits for every dispatched companion to return before writing the report, and does NOT invent findings for one still pending

evals.prompt: Review PR 3102 in elastic/docs-content. It is a small, well-written change: it corrects a default timeout value on one how-to page, the applies_to tags are already correct, the wording follows the style guide, and the PR body links to the engineering issue confirming the new value.
evals.expected_output: Runs the full checklist, finds nothing blocking, notes the SME evidence in the PR body, and recommends Approve without manufacturing findings.
expectations: Recommends Approve
Marks criteria that were checked and came back clean as Clean, distinct from Not checked
Does NOT manufacture low-value findings to appear thorough
Does NOT report unrelated pre-existing issues as blockers; any such observation appears in a separate pre-existing section
Notes that the linked engineering issue provides the authoritative source for the changed value

evals.prompt: Review PR 2903 in elastic/docs-content. It deletes deploy-manage/monitoring/stack-monitoring-legacy.md and folds the content into deploy-manage/monitoring/stack-monitoring.md. The diff does not touch redirects.yml.
evals.expected_output: Flags the missing redirect as a high-severity maintainability finding, checks whether images or snippets from the deleted page are now orphaned or still referenced, and recommends Request changes.
expectations: Flags the missing redirects.yml entry for the deleted page at High severity under Maintainability
Greps the repository for remaining references to the deleted page path
Checks whether images or snippets used only by the deleted page are now unused
Recommends Request changes, because broken incoming links prevent users from reaching the content

evals.prompt: Review PR 2481 in elastic/docs-content. (The working tree is currently on the main branch, not the PR head ref, and has no uncommitted changes.)
evals.expected_output: Detects that the checked-out ref does not match the PR head ref, surfaces the mismatch, and asks before running gh pr checkout rather than silently reviewing the base tree.
expectations: Detects and reports the mismatch between the PR head ref and the checked-out branch
Asks the user before running gh pr checkout, and does NOT check out the branch without confirmation
If the user declines, marks repository hygiene checks as Not checked because they ran against a different ref
Does NOT report orphaned-image or missing-redirect checks as clean while on the wrong ref

evals.prompt: Review PR 2755 in elastic/docs-content. (Only docs-check-style and content-type-checker are installed; check-contradictions, frontmatter-audit, and flag-jargon-skill are not installed on this machine, and the elastic-internal-docs MCP is not reachable.)
evals.expected_output: Loads the rubric from references/review-criteria.md, reports the criteria whose companions are missing as Not checked with the install command, and does not present unchecked criteria as clean.
expectations: Reads references/review-criteria.md and states in the report header that the rubric was not refreshed because the MCP is unreachable
Marks the criteria backed by the uninstalled companions as Not checked, naming each missing skill
Gives the install command using the directory name, for example 'check-contradictions', not the frontmatter name 'docs-check-contradictions'
Does NOT substitute its own judgment for a companion that did not run, and does NOT mark those criteria Clean
Still completes the orchestrator-only checks in Step 4 and produces a recommended action
